blocks.zh: 注射劑中可見微粒 — 完整教學版
blocks.en: Visible Particulates in Injections: Complete Teaching Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP〈790〉的強制性地位：所有注射劑產品在批次放行前必須通過可見微粒目視檢查
blocks.en: Understand the mandatory status of USP <790>: every injectable product must pass visual inspection for visible particulates before batch release

blocks.zh: 掌握「essentially free（基本上無可見微粒）」的法定定義及其在 AQL 抽樣中的量化標準
blocks.en: Master the legal definition of "essentially free" of visible particulates and its quantitative expression in AQL sampling

blocks.zh: 了解目視檢查的標準操作條件：照度（2000–3750 lux）、黑白背景、5 秒檢查時間
blocks.en: Know the standard operating conditions for visual inspection: illumination (2000–3750 lux), black and white backgrounds, 5-second inspection time

blocks.zh: 認識 ANSI/ASQ Z1.4（ISO 2859-1）抽樣計畫在批次放行中的應用，以及 AQL 0.65% 的意義
blocks.en: Recognize how the ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) sampling plan is applied to batch release, and what an AQL of 0.65% means

blocks.zh: 掌握〈790〉與〈788〉（次可見微粒）和〈1790〉（指導性章節）的層級關係
blocks.en: Master the hierarchy between <790>, <788> (subvisible particles) and <1790> (informational chapter)

blocks.zh: 理解 CDMO 充填線上 100% 目視檢查的實務要求：自動化 vs 人工、檢查員資格、缺陷分類
blocks.en: Understand the practical requirements for 100% visual inspection on a CDMO filling line: automated vs manual, inspector qualification, defect classification

blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP〈790〉的強制性地位：這是一個 mandatory（強制性） 通則章節 — 章節編號低於 1000 的 USP 通則在個別專論引用時具有法律約束力。與〈1790〉（編號 > 1000，屬於指導性 informational 章節）不同，〈790〉的要求在藥品註冊和 GMP 查廠中是必須滿足的。
blocks.en: Mandatory status of USP <790>: This is a mandatory general chapter. USP general chapters numbered below 1000 are legally enforceable when referenced by individual monographs. Unlike <1790> (numbered above 1000, an informational chapter), the requirements of <790> must be met in drug registration and in GMP inspections.

blocks.zh: Essentially Free（基本上無可見微粒）：不是「零微粒」，而是透過統計抽樣確認「不超過規定數量的單位含有可見微粒」。這個定義直接連結到 AQL 抽樣計畫
blocks.en: Essentially Free: This does not mean "zero particles". It means that statistical sampling confirms that "no more than a specified number of units contain visible particulates". The definition is tied directly to the AQL sampling plan

blocks.zh: Particulate Matter（微粒物質）：定義來自〈788〉— 外來的、可移動的、未溶解的顆粒，不包括氣泡。注意「extraneous（外來的）」這個詞 — 產品固有的顆粒（如蛋白質聚集體）有不同的控制規範
blocks.en: Particulate Matter: Defined in <788> as extraneous, mobile, undissolved particles, excluding gas bubbles. Note the word "extraneous": particles inherent to the product (such as protein aggregates) are controlled by different specifications

blocks.zh: Inherent vs Extraneous：如果產品本身會形成可見顆粒（如某些蛋白質藥物的聚集體），其接受標準由個別專論或核准的上市申請書規定，但外來微粒仍須遵守〈790〉
blocks.en: Inherent vs Extraneous: If the product itself forms visible particles (for example, aggregates of certain protein drugs), the acceptance criteria are set by the individual monograph or the approved marketing application, but extraneous particles must still comply with <790>

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 飲水機的品質標準：
blocks.en: Quality standard for bottled water:

blocks.zh: 想像你負責管理一家公司的瓶裝水生產線。「essentially free」就像規定：每 1000 瓶水中，允許有不超過特定數量的瓶子在燈光下看到漂浮物。不是說「一顆都不能有」（那在工業生產中不現實），而是用統計方法確保整批的品質水準。
blocks.en: Imagine you manage a bottled-water production line. "Essentially free" works like a rule that, out of every 1000 bottles, no more than a specified number may show floating matter under the light. It does not say "not a single one" (unrealistic in industrial production); instead, statistical methods ensure the quality level of the whole batch.

blocks.zh: 而且，如果水裡本來就有礦物質沉澱（inherent particles），那有另外的標準管理。但如果是從瓶蓋掉進去的塑膠碎片（extraneous particles），不管你的水本身有沒有沉澱，這個外來汙染都不可接受。
blocks.en: Also, if the water naturally contains mineral sediment (inherent particles), a separate standard governs that. But a plastic fragment that fell in from the bottle cap (an extraneous particle) is unacceptable, regardless of whether the water has natural sediment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 充填線上的合規要點：
blocks.en: Compliance points on the filling line:

blocks.zh: 100% 製程內目視檢查是基礎要求 — 每一瓶都必須經過目視檢查（人工或自動化）
blocks.en: 100% in-process visual inspection is the baseline requirement: every vial must be visually inspected (manually or automatically)

blocks.zh: 100% 檢查之後，批次放行前還需要按照 ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 進行統計抽樣檢查
blocks.en: After 100% inspection, statistical sampling inspection per ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 is still required before batch release

blocks.zh: 對於凍乾產品（乾粉），通常在充填封蓋後無法看到溶液狀態，需要在復溶後抽樣檢查
blocks.en: For lyophilized products (dry powder), the solution state usually cannot be seen after filling and closing, so sampling inspection is performed after reconstitution

blocks.zh: 客戶可能有比 USP 更嚴格的內部標準（例如 AQL 0.10% 而非 0.65%），CDMO 須與客戶確認適用的接受標準
blocks.en: A client may have internal standards stricter than USP (for example, AQL 0.10% rather than 0.65%); the CDMO must confirm the applicable acceptance criteria with the client

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 〈790〉vs〈788〉vs〈1790〉的層級關係：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of <790> vs <788> vs <1790>:

blocks.zh: 限制性檢查的情況：對於深色容器、懸浮液、高度著色液體等難以直接目視檢查的產品，必須從批次中抽取樣品，將內容物取出後進行檢查。這屬於破壞性檢查，因此樣品量較小。
blocks.en: Cases of limited inspection capability: For products that are difficult to inspect directly, such as dark containers, suspensions and strongly colored liquids, samples must be drawn from the batch and the contents removed for inspection. This is destructive inspection, so the sample size is smaller.

blocks.zh: Inspection Procedure — 檢查程序
blocks.en: Inspection Procedure

blocks.zh: 檢查條件的三大要素：
blocks.en: Three key elements of inspection conditions:

blocks.zh: 照度 2000–3750 lux：這是經過科學驗證的最適範圍。低於 2000 lux 會漏看淺色或透明微粒；高於 3750 lux 則可能產生眩光（glare），反而降低檢測靈敏度。注意：對於深色溶液或非透明容器，建議使用更高照度
blocks.en: Illumination of 2000–3750 lux: This is the scientifically validated optimal range. Below 2000 lux, light-colored or transparent particles are missed; above 3750 lux, glare may occur and actually reduce detection sensitivity. Note: for dark solutions or opaque containers, higher illumination is recommended

blocks.zh: 黑白雙背景：白色微粒在黑色背景下最容易發現；深色微粒（如金屬、橡膠碎片）在白色背景下最明顯。兩種背景缺一不可
blocks.en: Black and white backgrounds: White particles are easiest to see against a black background; dark particles (such as metal or rubber fragments) are most obvious against a white background. Both backgrounds are indispensable

blocks.zh: 裸眼檢查：不使用放大鏡 — 這是關鍵限定。允許的只有矯正視力的眼鏡或隱形眼鏡。這代表〈790〉的檢測對象是肉眼可見的微粒（通常 ≥ 100–150 μm）
blocks.en: Unaided eye: No magnifying lens is used, which is a key limitation. Only corrective eyeglasses or contact lenses are allowed. This means <790> targets particles visible to the naked eye (typically ≥ 100–150 μm)

blocks.zh: 操作手法：輕輕旋轉和/或翻轉容器，目的是讓沉積在底部或附著在壁面的微粒浮動起來，但不能產生氣泡（氣泡會干擾微粒判讀）。每個背景檢查約 5 秒 — 總共約 10 秒/瓶。
blocks.en: Technique: Gently swirl and/or invert the container so that particles settled at the bottom or clinging to the wall are set in motion, but without generating bubbles (bubbles interfere with particle assessment). Each background is inspected for about 5 seconds, for a total of about 10 seconds per vial.

blocks.zh: 珠寶鑑定的標準化：
blocks.en: Standardization in gem grading:

blocks.zh: 這就像珠寶鑑定師鑑定鑽石淨度。你不能在昏暗的酒吧裡看（照度不夠），也不能拿著放大鏡看（那會看到不同等級的瑕疵）。行業標準規定了特定的燈光條件和裸眼觀察 — 確保全球每個鑑定師在相同條件下得出可比較的結論。
blocks.en: This is like a gemologist grading the clarity of a diamond. You cannot do it in a dimly lit bar (insufficient illumination), nor with a magnifying glass (which would reveal flaws of a different grade). The industry standard specifies particular lighting conditions and unaided-eye observation, so that every grader worldwide reaches comparable conclusions under the same conditions.

blocks.zh: 黑白背景的邏輯也很直觀：就像你在白紙上容易看到黑點，在黑紙上容易看到白點一樣。兩個都看，才不會遺漏。
blocks.en: The logic of black and white backgrounds is also intuitive: just as black dots are easy to see on white paper and white dots on black paper, you need to look against both so that nothing is missed.

blocks.zh: 100% 檢查 + 抽樣檢查 = 雙重保障：
blocks.en: 100% inspection + sampling inspection = double assurance:

blocks.zh: 〈790〉明確指出這個程序是「搭配製程中 100% 檢查」使用的。這意味著：
blocks.en: <790> states explicitly that this procedure is used in conjunction with 100% inspection during manufacture. This means:

blocks.zh: 第一道防線：充填線上的 100% 目視檢查（製程內控制，即 IPC）— 剔除明顯有微粒的單位
blocks.en: First line of defense: 100% visual inspection on the filling line (in-process control, IPC), which rejects units with obvious particulates

blocks.zh: 第二道防線：批次放行前的統計抽樣（本章描述的程序）— 確認整批品質
blocks.en: Second line of defense: statistical sampling before batch release (the procedure described in this chapter), which confirms the quality of the whole batch

blocks.zh: 光源選擇：原文提到螢光燈管（F13/T5 或 F15/T8），但也允許替代光源（如白熾燈、LED），只要照度在規定範圍內。現代檢查站多使用高品質 LED 光源，光譜更穩定且無頻閃。
blocks.en: Choice of light source: The original text mentions fluorescent tubes (F13/T5 or F15/T8), but alternative sources (such as incandescent lamps or LEDs) are also permitted as long as the illumination is within the specified range. Modern inspection stations mostly use high-quality LED sources, which have a more stable spectrum and no flicker.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 自動化 vs 人工目視檢查
blocks.en: Key Notes: Automated vs Manual Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: CDMO 充填線的現實選擇：
blocks.en: The practical choice on a CDMO filling line:

blocks.zh: 無論使用人工或自動化，批次放行前仍須按〈790〉進行統計抽樣。自動化機器的「reject」品不代表批次不合格 — 要看抽樣結果。
blocks.en: Whether manual or automated inspection is used, statistical sampling per <790> is still required before batch release. Units rejected by an automated machine do not mean the batch fails; what counts is the sampling result.

blocks.zh: Sampling at Batch Release (After 100% Manufacturing Inspection) — 批次放行抽樣
blocks.en: Sampling at Batch Release (After 100% Manufacturing Inspection)

blocks.zh: AQL 抽樣計畫的關鍵參數：
blocks.en: Key parameters of the AQL sampling plan:

blocks.zh: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4（等同 ISO 2859-1）：這是國際通用的計數型抽樣檢驗標準，用於判定批次是否合格。製藥業的目視檢查普遍採用此標準
blocks.en: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (equivalent to ISO 2859-1): This is the internationally accepted attribute sampling inspection standard used to decide whether a batch is acceptable. It is widely used for visual inspection in the pharmaceutical industry

blocks.zh: General Inspection Level II：標準檢驗水準，提供中等程度的鑑別力。Level I 樣本數較少（較寬鬆），Level III 樣本數較多（較嚴格）
blocks.en: General Inspection Level II: The standard inspection level, providing a moderate degree of discrimination. Level I has a smaller sample size (less stringent) and Level III a larger sample size (more stringent)

blocks.zh: AQL 0.65%：Acceptable Quality Limit — 允收品質水準。表示當批次中的不良率為 0.65% 時，該批被允收的機率約為 95%。注意：AQL 不是容許不良率的上限，而是一個統計機率的基準點
blocks.en: AQL 0.65%: Acceptable Quality Limit. It means that when the batch defective rate is 0.65%, the probability of accepting the batch is about 95%. Note: the AQL is not an upper limit on the permitted defective rate; it is a statistical probability reference point

blocks.zh: NMT（Not More Than）：樣本中含有可見微粒的單位數不得超過 Z1.4 表格中對應的允收數（Ac）
blocks.en: NMT (Not More Than): The number of units in the sample containing visible particulates must not exceed the acceptance number (Ac) given in the Z1.4 table

blocks.zh: AQL 抽樣範例 Sampling Example
blocks.en: Sampling Example

blocks.zh: 批量 35,001–150,000 瓶（常見的 CDMO 批次大小）：
blocks.en: Lot size 35,001–150,000 vials (a common CDMO batch size):

blocks.zh:
General Inspection Level II → Sample Size Code Letter = N
Sample Size Code N → n = 500 units

AQL = 0.65%
Ac (Accept number) = 7
Re (Reject number) = 8

判定規則：
  抽 500 瓶 → 檢查發現含可見微粒的瓶數
  ≤ 7 瓶 → 批次允收（Pass）
  ≥ 8 瓶 → 批次拒收（Fail）
blocks.en:
General Inspection Level II → Sample Size Code Letter = N
Sample Size Code N → n = 500 units

AQL = 0.65%
Ac (Accept number) = 7
Re (Reject number) = 8

Decision rule:
  Draw 500 vials → count vials with visible particulates found
  ≤ 7 vials → batch accepted (Pass)
  ≥ 8 vials → batch rejected (Fail)

blocks.zh: 重要：不同批量大小對應不同的代碼字母和樣本數。務必查閱 Z1.4 表格確定正確的 n、Ac、Re 值。
blocks.en: Important: Different lot sizes correspond to different code letters and sample sizes. Always consult the Z1.4 tables to determine the correct n, Ac and Re values.

blocks.zh: 「等效或更佳保護」的替代方案：原文允許使用替代抽樣計畫，但必須提供等效或更佳的品質保護。常見的替代方案包括：
blocks.en: Alternative plans offering "equivalent or better protection": The original text permits alternative sampling plans, but they must provide equivalent or better quality protection. Common alternatives include:

blocks.zh: 使用 Tightened Inspection（加嚴檢驗）作為批次放行的常規標準
blocks.en: Use Tightened Inspection as the routine standard for batch release

blocks.zh: 使用 AQL 0.10%（更嚴格）取代 0.65% — 某些客戶或法規體系可能要求
blocks.en: Use AQL 0.10% (stricter) instead of 0.65%, which some clients or regulatory systems may require

blocks.zh: 對於高風險產品（如眼科注射劑），客戶可能要求 零缺點抽樣計畫（c = 0 plans）
blocks.en: For high-risk products (such as ophthalmic injectables), the client may require zero-defect sampling plans (c = 0 plans)

blocks.zh: CDMO 注意事項：你的品保部門必須建立一套轉換規則（Switching Rules） — 何時從正常檢驗轉為加嚴或減量檢驗。這些規則必須與客戶協議中的品質標準一致。
blocks.en: CDMO note: Your quality assurance department must establish switching rules defining when to move from normal inspection to tightened or reduced inspection. These rules must be consistent with the quality standards in the client agreement.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Inspector Qualification
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: Inspector Qualification

blocks.zh: 目視檢查員的資格管理：
blocks.en: Qualification management of visual inspectors:

blocks.zh: 視力要求：近距離視力 20/20（矯正後可），須定期測試（通常每年一次）
blocks.en: Visual acuity: Near-vision acuity of 20/20 (corrected is acceptable), tested periodically (usually annually)

blocks.zh: 初始培訓：使用已知含有微粒的標準品組（knuth set / defect standard set）進行訓練
blocks.en: Initial training: Training with standard sets known to contain particles (Knapp set / defect standard set)

blocks.zh: 資格確認：通過標準品測試 — 對已知缺陷品的檢出率須達標（通常 ≥ 70%）
blocks.en: Qualification: Pass the standard set test; the detection rate for known defective units must meet the target (usually ≥ 70%)

blocks.zh: 定期再確認：每 6–12 個月重新確認資格
blocks.en: Periodic requalification: Re-confirm qualification every 6–12 months

blocks.zh: 疲勞管理：連續檢查時間不超過 30–45 分鐘，須安排休息（EU GMP Annex 1 要求）
blocks.en: Fatigue management: Continuous inspection time should not exceed 30–45 minutes, with breaks scheduled (an EU GMP Annex 1 expectation)

blocks.zh: 這些要求在〈790〉本身並未詳細規定，但在 EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) 和〈1790〉中有詳盡指引。
blocks.en: These requirements are not specified in detail in <790> itself, but are covered in depth in EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) and <1790>.

blocks.zh: Product in Distribution — 流通中產品
blocks.en: Product in Distribution

blocks.zh: 流通中產品檢查的適用條件：
blocks.en: Conditions for inspecting product in distribution:

blocks.zh: 前提條件：此檢查僅適用於已通過批次放行抽樣的產品。如果批次從未完成過〈790〉放行抽樣，不能用這個簡化程序
blocks.en: Prerequisite: This inspection applies only to product that has already passed batch release sampling. If a batch never completed the <790> release sampling, this simplified procedure cannot be used

blocks.zh: 觸發情境：客戶投訴（收到含微粒的產品）、法規機構要求調查、安定性研究發現問題等
blocks.en: Triggering situations: a customer complaint (receipt of product containing particles), a regulatory authority request for investigation, a problem found in a stability study, and so on

blocks.zh: 樣本量 20 單位：比批次放行的抽樣數量小得多。這反映了產品已經通過了先前的全面檢查，此處只是額外的確認
blocks.en: Sample size of 20 units: Much smaller than the sample size for batch release. This reflects that the product has already passed the earlier full inspection, and this is only additional confirmation

blocks.zh: 判定標準：20 單位中 0 個含可見微粒 = 合格。任何一個含微粒都需要進一步調查
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: 0 of 20 units containing visible particulates = acceptable. Any unit containing particles requires further investigation

blocks.zh: CDMO 的客訴處理流程連結：
blocks.en: Link to the CDMO complaint-handling process:

blocks.zh: 當收到客戶的微粒投訴時，典型的調查流程：
blocks.en: When a particulate complaint is received from a customer, the typical investigation flow is:

blocks.zh: 確認批次放行記錄：調出該批次的〈790〉AQL 抽樣結果 — 是否通過？結果如何？
blocks.en: Confirm the batch release records: Retrieve the <790> AQL sampling results for the batch. Did it pass? What were the results?

blocks.zh: 留樣檢查：從保留樣品（retention sample）中取 20 單位進行〈790〉檢查
blocks.en: Retention sample inspection: Take 20 units from the retention sample and inspect them per <790>

blocks.zh: 微粒鑑別：如果發現微粒，進行微粒鑑別分析（FTIR、SEM-EDX 等），確定來源（容器、膠塞、製程環境、產品降解）
blocks.en: Particle identification: If particles are found, perform particle identification analysis (FTIR, SEM-EDX, etc.) to determine the source (container, stopper, process environment, product degradation)

blocks.zh: 風險評估：評估微粒對患者安全的影響，決定是否需要回收
blocks.en: Risk assessment: Assess the impact of the particles on patient safety and decide whether a recall is needed

blocks.zh: CAPA：根據根因分析啟動矯正與預防措施
blocks.en: CAPA: Initiate corrective and preventive actions based on root cause analysis

blocks.zh: 汽車出廠檢查 vs 召回檢驗：
blocks.en: Factory-outgoing inspection vs recall inspection for cars:

blocks.zh: 批次放行的 AQL 抽樣就像汽車出廠前的品管抽檢 — 每批車都要抽一定比例做全面檢查。而「流通中產品檢查」就像接到車主投訴後的調查 — 你不需要把所有賣出去的車都召回檢查，只需要抽幾台（20 單位）確認問題是否普遍存在。但前提是這批車當初有通過出廠品管（批次放行），否則這個簡化程序不適用。
blocks.en: AQL sampling at batch release is like quality sampling before cars leave the factory: a certain proportion of every batch of cars gets a full inspection. "Inspection of product in distribution" is like the investigation after an owner complaint: you do not need to recall and inspect every car sold, only a few (20 units) to confirm whether the problem is widespread. But this presupposes that the batch passed the factory quality check (batch release) in the first place; otherwise this simplified procedure does not apply.

blocks.zh: CDMO Context: Defect Classification — CDMO 情境：缺陷分類
blocks.en: CDMO Context: Defect Classification

blocks.zh: 延伸內容 Extended Context
blocks.en: Extended Context

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 缺陷分類的雙層邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Two-Tier Logic of Defect Classification

blocks.zh: 100% 檢查 vs AQL 抽樣的不同標準：
blocks.en: Different standards for 100% inspection vs AQL sampling:

blocks.zh: 這裡有一個經常被混淆的概念：
blocks.en: Here is a concept that is often confused:

blocks.zh: 100% 線上檢查時：可見微粒是「critical defect」，發現即剔除，不存在「可接受」的微粒瓶
blocks.en: During 100% in-line inspection: Visible particles are a "critical defect"; once found, the unit is rejected, and there is no such thing as an "acceptable" particulate vial

blocks.zh: AQL 抽樣時（〈790〉）：AQL 0.65% 是在批次放行時使用的統計工具。它承認的現實是 — 即使經過 100% 檢查，仍可能有少數含微粒的單位漏檢
blocks.en: During AQL sampling (<790>): AQL 0.65% is the statistical tool used at batch release. It acknowledges the reality that, even after 100% inspection, a few units containing particles may still be missed

blocks.zh: 換句話說：100% 檢查的目標是「零缺陷通過」，但 AQL 抽樣承認檢查並非完美，因此用統計方法確認漏檢率在可接受範圍內。
blocks.en: In other words, the goal of 100% inspection is "zero defects passing", but AQL sampling acknowledges that inspection is not perfect, and uses statistical methods to confirm that the miss rate is within an acceptable range.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) 對目視檢查的要求
blocks.en: Key Notes: EU GMP Annex 1 (2023) Requirements for Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 歐盟最新的 Annex 1 對目視檢查有更詳細的規定（第 8.22–8.25 節）：
blocks.en: The latest EU Annex 1 has more detailed provisions on visual inspection (sections 8.22–8.25):

blocks.zh: 100% 目視檢查是必須的（不僅是建議）
blocks.en: 100% visual inspection is mandatory (not merely recommended)

blocks.zh: 自動化檢查系統必須經過驗證，證明其等效於或優於人工檢查
blocks.en: Automated inspection systems must be validated to demonstrate that they are equivalent or superior to manual inspection

blocks.zh: 檢查員需要定期再確認其檢測能力
blocks.en: Inspectors must be periodically requalified on their detection ability

blocks.zh: 必須記錄拒收率趨勢並進行調查
blocks.en: The reject rate trend must be recorded and investigated

blocks.zh: 被自動化系統拒絕的單位不得未經人工確認就重新引入生產流程
blocks.en: Units rejected by an automated system must not be reintroduced into the production flow without manual confirmation

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，如果你的產品要出口歐盟市場，必須同時符合 USP〈790〉和 EU GMP Annex 1 的要求。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, if your product is exported to the EU market, it must comply with both USP <790> and EU GMP Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼可見微粒在 100% 檢查中被歸類為「critical defect」（AQL = 0%），但〈790〉的批次放行抽樣卻使用 AQL 0.65%？這兩個標準是否矛盾？
blocks.en: Why are visible particulates classified as a "critical defect" (AQL = 0%) in 100% inspection, yet <790> batch release sampling uses AQL 0.65%? Are these two standards contradictory?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 充填線使用自動化目視檢查機（AVI），機器拒收率（reject rate）突然從平均 1.2% 上升到 3.5%。你會如何調查？這與〈790〉的批次放行判定有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Your CDMO filling line uses an automated visual inspection (AVI) machine, and the reject rate suddenly rises from an average of 1.2% to 3.5%. How would you investigate? How does this relate to the <790> batch release decision?

blocks.zh: 一位歐洲客戶要求你對其產品使用 AQL 0.10%（比 USP〈790〉的 0.65% 更嚴格）。這在〈790〉的框架下是否允許？你會如何評估這對產能和成本的影響？
blocks.en: A European client asks you to use AQL 0.10% (stricter than the 0.65% in USP <790>) for its product. Is this permitted within the <790> framework? How would you assess the impact on capacity and cost?

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品在充填封蓋後無法進行常規目視檢查。根據〈790〉Introduction 中關於「limited capability for inspection」的規定，你會設計什麼樣的檢查方案？
blocks.en: Lyophilized products cannot undergo routine visual inspection after filling and closing. Based on the "limited capability for inspection" provision in the <790> Introduction, what inspection scheme would you design?

blocks.zh: Footnotes & Cross-References — 註釋與交叉參照
blocks.en: Footnotes & Cross-References

blocks.zh: 〈1〉 Injections and Implanted Drug Products — 注射劑與植入式藥品（母章節）
blocks.en: <1> Injections and Implanted Drug Products (parent chapter)

blocks.zh: 〈787〉 Subvisible Particulate Matter in Therapeutic Protein Injections — 治療性蛋白質注射劑次可見微粒
blocks.en: <787> Subvisible Particulate Matter in Therapeutic Protein Injections

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 Particulate Matter in Injections — 注射劑中微粒物質（次可見微粒，≥10 μm / ≥25 μm）
blocks.en: <788> Particulate Matter in Injections (subvisible particles, ≥10 μm / ≥25 μm)

blocks.zh: 〈1790〉 Visual Inspection of Injections (Informational) — 注射劑目視檢查（指導性章節）
blocks.en: <1790> Visual Inspection of Injections (Informational)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 USP 微粒控制體系的完整架構
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Complete Architecture of the USP Particulate Control System

blocks.zh: USP 建構了一個分層的微粒控制體系，每個章節負責不同尺寸範圍的微粒：
blocks.en: USP builds a tiered particulate control system, with each chapter responsible for a different particle size range:

blocks.zh: 〈1〉注射劑 — 母章節（產品整體品質要求）
blocks.en: <1> Injections: parent chapter (overall product quality requirements)

blocks.zh: 〈790〉可見微粒（≥~100 μm，目視檢查）
blocks.en: <790> Visible particulates (≥ ~100 μm, visual inspection)
<788> / <787> Subvisible particulates (≥10 μm / ≥25 μm, instrumental testing)

blocks.zh: 〈1790〉的角色：作為指導性章節，〈1790〉提供了目視檢查的最佳實務、檢查員培訓方法、自動化檢查的驗證策略等詳細指引。雖然不具強制力，但在建立目視檢查 SOP 時是最重要的參考文件。
blocks.en: The role of <1790>: As an informational chapter, <1790> provides detailed guidance on visual inspection best practices, inspector training methods, validation strategies for automated inspection and more. Although it is not enforceable, it is the most important reference when establishing a visual inspection SOP.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 完整的微粒控制策略
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: A Complete Particulate Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 一個符合 USP 和 EU GMP 的完整微粒控制計畫應包含：
blocks.en: A complete particulate control plan compliant with USP and EU GMP should include:

blocks.zh: 製程控制（Process Controls）：環境監測、組件清潔驗證、濾芯完整性測試
blocks.en: Process controls: environmental monitoring, component cleaning validation, filter integrity testing

blocks.zh: 100% 目視檢查（〈790〉+ Annex 1）：充填線上人工或自動化檢查
blocks.en: 100% visual inspection (<790> + Annex 1): manual or automated inspection on the filling line

blocks.zh: AQL 統計抽樣（〈790〉）：批次放行前的正式抽樣判定
blocks.en: AQL statistical sampling (<790>): formal sampling-based disposition before batch release

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒測試（〈788〉/〈787〉）：光阻法或顯微鏡法測量 ≥10 μm 和 ≥25 μm 的微粒
blocks.en: Subvisible particle testing (<788> / <787>): light obscuration or microscopic methods to measure particles ≥10 μm and ≥25 μm

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析與 CAPA：追蹤拒收率趨勢、微粒鑑別結果，持續改善
blocks.en: Trend analysis and CAPA: track reject rate trends and particle identification results for continual improvement

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Special Level 抽樣計畫
blocks.en: Key Notes: Special Level Sampling Plans

blocks.zh: Footnote 1 的實務意義：
blocks.en: Practical significance of Footnote 1:

blocks.zh: 對於無法進行非破壞性檢查的產品（如凍乾品、深色容器），〈790〉建議使用 Z1.4 的 Special Inspection Levels（S-1 至 S-4）。這些級別的樣本量比 General Level II 小得多，適用於破壞性檢查的經濟性考量。
blocks.en: For products that cannot undergo non-destructive inspection (such as lyophilized products and dark containers), <790> suggests using the Z1.4 Special Inspection Levels (S-1 to S-4). The sample sizes at these levels are much smaller than General Level II, which suits the economics of destructive inspection.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: USP〈790〉是強制性通則 — 所有注射劑產品必須在批次放行前通過可見微粒目視檢查，不可豁免
blocks.en: USP <790> is a mandatory general chapter: every injectable product must pass visual inspection for visible particulates before batch release, with no exemption

blocks.zh: 「Essentially Free」的量化定義：透過 ANSI/ASQ Z1.4（ISO 2859-1）General Inspection Level II，AQL 0.65% 的統計抽樣來判定
blocks.en: Quantitative definition of "Essentially Free": determined by statistical sampling under ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) General Inspection Level II at AQL 0.65%

blocks.zh: 檢查條件標準化：照度 2000–3750 lux、黑白雙背景、裸眼（矯正視力可）、每背景約 5 秒，輕輕旋轉/翻轉不產生氣泡
blocks.en: Standardized inspection conditions: illumination of 2000–3750 lux, black and white backgrounds, unaided eye (corrective eyewear permitted), about 5 seconds per background, gentle swirling/inversion without generating bubbles

blocks.zh: 雙重防線架構：製程內 100% 目視檢查（IPC）+ 批次放行 AQL 統計抽樣（〈790〉）
blocks.en: Double line of defense: in-process 100% visual inspection (IPC) + AQL statistical sampling at batch release (<790>)

blocks.zh: 流通中產品檢查：僅適用於已通過批次放行的產品，抽 20 單位，零缺陷通過
blocks.en: Inspection of product in distribution: applies only to product that has passed batch release; draw 20 units; pass with zero defects

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務整合：缺陷分類體系、檢查員資格管理、自動化驗證、EU GMP Annex 1 合規，以及與〈788〉、〈787〉、〈1790〉的整合
blocks.en: CDMO practical integration: defect classification system, inspector qualification management, automated inspection validation, EU GMP Annex 1 compliance, and integration with <788>, <787> and <1790>
